baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ع ج ب in the conditional and answer, joined to قولهم and كفروا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse first permits wonder, then redirects it: the remarkable object is not renewed creation but a denial voiced as a settled position. The repeated root makes the hearer's astonishment recoil onto the speakers.

activation_trace.role: Unfamiliarity is doubled so surprise turns back from resurrection onto the denial itself.
The utterance as a held position makes the question a creed rather than passing amazement.
Covered truth supplies the epistemic closure that makes the position itself astonishing.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection is the extraordinary thing under discussion.
changed_reading.after: The verse relocates extraordinariness into the confident speech that treats renewed creation as impossible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كنا ترابا ... خلق جديد sequences a former state, material substrate, creation, and newness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dust is a material condition rather than sheer absence; creation combines prior measure with origination, while newness carries occurrence across a cut. The disputed transition can therefore be read as measured reconfiguration after discontinuity.

activation_trace.role: Past occurrence gives dust a temporal state rather than terminal nonbeing.
Earth and dust supply the decomposed material substrate.
Prior measuring makes creation an ordered operation.
Origination supplies the passage into another formed existence.
Occurrence after severance makes newness a discontinuous renewal.

changed_reading.before: New creation means an inexplicable replacement after matter has vanished.
changed_reading.after: New creation is a measured re-forming of extant dust across a real break in continuity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The threefold أولئك advances from كفروا to الأغلال في أعناقهم to أصحاب النار ... خالدون.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated designation builds a topology rather than a loose penalty list: epistemic covering is followed by a collar fixed at the body's steering joint, then by companionship with an environment and lasting adhesion to it.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the closed epistemic condition named first.
A restraining collar turns closure into bodily immobilization.
The neck locates restraint at the junction of perception, speech, and bodily direction.
Companionship converts a destination into an enduring relation.
Kindled fire supplies the encompassing habitat of that relation.
Clinging and abiding make permanence spatially adhesive, not merely long.

changed_reading.before: Chains, fire, and eternity are three independent punishments.
changed_reading.after: They form one progressive confinement: closed knowing becomes neck-bound agency, durable affiliation, and finally an inescapable habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth sequence supplies one medium, related growth from one stock, one watering, and unequal yield. It turns dust-to-new-creation from an unexampled leap into the intensified form of an already visible differentiation process.

activation_trace.role: Dust anchors the disputed renewal in terrestrial material.
Origination names the transformation whose possibility is challenged.
Renewal after a break is the outcome illuminated by the growth sequence.
State-making supplies an observable transformation operator in the earth.
Shoots emerging from one stock supply materially shared origin with differentiated forms.
Watering supplies the common life-bearing input.
Numerical oneness marks that input as the same rather than merely similar.
Increase and remainder account for unequal outcomes from the common medium.

structural_cues: 13:3-4 place paired growth, common watering, and visibly unequal produce immediately before the focus question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared stock, one input, and divergent outcomes; I infer that visible differentiation from a common medium models the possibility of dust becoming another form. A live alternative is that the sequence offers signs only, not a material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Return from dust is unlike any process available to perception.
changed_reading.after: The preceding earth is already a laboratory in which one substrate and one input repeatedly issue in differentiated, renewed forms.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gestation makes a body a hidden balance of carrying, loss, increase, and exact measure. The focus transition from dust to a new creation can thus be carried as concealed staged formation, not only instantaneous replacement.

activation_trace.role: Former being supplies one temporal state in a longer process.
Dust supplies the materially reduced state from which the question begins.
Measurement within creation aligns the focus with quantified formation.
New occurrence names the completed state after hidden transitions.
Internal carrying supplies a concealed material formation process.
Subtraction makes loss one controlled phase rather than annihilation.
The womb locates unseen transformation inside a bounded chamber.
Growth supplies the counter-motion to loss.
Exact extent constrains both decrease and increase within a determinate form.

structural_cues: 13:8 repeats what is carried, diminished, and increased before closing with measure; 13:9 immediately pairs hidden and witnessed domains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a concealed body formed by measured loss and gain; I infer a process analogy to re-creation from dust. The live alternative is reproductive comparison without identity between gestation and resurrection.

changed_reading.before: New creation is a single opaque jump after decomposition.
changed_reading.after: It can also be read as a hidden, measured sequence in which subtraction and accretion culminate in a newly bounded body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context locates consequential change within selves and then closes the resulting evil with no repeller. Activated beside the concealed rancor and literal collar branches of غ ل ل, the neck-chain can externalize an inwardly stabilized refusal.

activation_trace.role: Truth-covering supplies the inward epistemic refusal.
Latent rancor supplies an interior constriction beneath the visible chain.
The collar gives that constriction an external bodily form.
The neck makes the interior-to-exterior conversion anatomically legible.
Alteration of form supplies the context's explicit change operator.
Mind and inward awareness locate the decisive change within the subject.
Repulsion and prevention supply the terminal non-reversibility of the resulting condition.

structural_cues: 13:11 moves from guarded exteriority to change within selves and then to an outcome that cannot be repelled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inner change, concealed rancor, an outer collar, and blocked reversal; I infer an inward-to-outward crystallization. The live alternative is a literal imposed restraint with no psychosomatic direction.

changed_reading.before: The chain is only an externally imposed instrument after disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The chain may also render inward refusal visible: a hidden constriction hardens into the body's governing posture and becomes non-reversible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same mapped root that names focus fire later names light, while the surrounding question asks whether rival making has confused creation. This activates fire as an inverted illumination: brightness that exposes and marks without becoming guidance.

activation_trace.role: Covering sets the epistemic problem against which illumination is tested.
Kindled fire is the punitive member of the shared luminous root.
Light supplies the guiding counterpart that exposes the focus fire's inversion.
Repeated origination keeps the contrast attached to the focus dispute over renewed creation.
Confusion by resemblance supplies the mechanism by which luminous things can be mistaken for equivalent guidance.

structural_cues: 13:16 sets blind against seeing and darkness against light, then repeats creation until imagined creators make it confused.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire and light under one mapped root plus a creation-confusion sequence; I infer a rhetorical inversion from guiding light to exposing fire. The live alternative is ordinary lexical kinship with no deliberate cross-ayah mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Fire contributes heat and punishment only.
changed_reading.after: Fire also becomes failed or hostile illumination: it makes the covered condition visible but does not grant sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured water and smelting fire separate floating residue from what remains beneficial. Against that assay, focus permanence is no longer a generic badge of durability: companionship and clinging specify what one persists with and where.

activation_trace.role: Companionship types permanence by relation rather than duration alone.
Fire links the focus habitat to the context's material assay.
Long stability poses the value-neutral persistence that the assay revises.
Adhesion explains why remaining in fire differs from beneficial matter remaining on earth.
Channel-specific measure supplies controlled differentiation.
Floating froth supplies conspicuous but transient residue in both water and fire processes.
Ignition supplies the refining process rather than a merely static blaze.
Remaining with waiting identifies the contrasting persistence of what benefits.

structural_cues: 13:17 repeats froth across water and smelting, then opposes its departure to beneficial matter's remaining.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two assays and two outcomes of persistence; I infer that the focus qualifies permanence relationally rather than praising endurance itself. The live alternative is that the material analogy concerns truth and falsehood without modifying the fire scene.

changed_reading.before: خالدون only enlarges punishment by adding endless time.
changed_reading.after: Permanence is an assayed relation: beneficial matter remains in its sustaining field, while these subjects remain adhesively attached to fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later ethical sequence is built from fastening, joining, unbinding, and severing. The focus collar becomes a counter-bond: agents who undo a protected bond and cut commanded connections are themselves joined by a constrictive bond at the neck.

activation_trace.role: The collar supplies the imposed counter-bond.
The neck makes the counter-bond govern bodily orientation.
Unmaking a firmly built thing supplies the prohibited loosening action.
A fastening restraint gives covenant its material bond-image.
Joining until attachment supplies the positive connective action.
Repetition of unbinding marks the negative group by topology, not topic alone.
Severing an existing connection completes the inversion answered by the collar.

structural_cues: 13:20-21 define the positive group by keeping and joining; 13:25 mirrors both verbs with unbinding and cutting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bind/join versus unbind/cut opposition and the focus supplies a neck-bond; I infer reciprocal topology between action and consequence. The live alternative is juridical correspondence without a deliberate material inversion.

changed_reading.before: The neck-chain is an arbitrary restraint appended to disbelief.
changed_reading.after: It is a precise counter-bond: cutting connective obligations yields compulsory attachment at the body's point of direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root permits both concealed rancor and a literal collar; the later doubled settling of hearts supplies an opposite inward configuration. Chain and tranquility become competing forms of fixation, one resentful and constrictive, the other recollective and settled.

activation_trace.role: Concealed rancor locates one form of binding inside the chest.
The collar externalizes that inward bind as constrained posture.
Clinging makes the hostile configuration self-maintaining.
Repeated settling supplies a non-constrictive mode of interior stability.
The heart identifies the interior site where the alternative configuration occurs.
Recollection supplies the motion that restores presence instead of covering it.

structural_cues: 13:28 doubles both remembrance and heart-settling, echoing the focus's doubled wonder while reversing its affective result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden rancor, an outer collar, and an opposed settled heart; I infer two embodied configurations of fixation. The live alternative keeps the collar wholly literal and treats the rancor branch as inactive.

changed_reading.before: A chain restrains the body while disbelief remains a separate proposition.
changed_reading.after: The chain can figure a whole hostile configuration in which covered recollection becomes inward rancor, outward constriction, and durable clinging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context imagines successively stronger ruptures of ordinary stability: mountains moved, earth cut, and the dead addressed. The focus question then reads less as a request for missing evidence than as a demand structure able to escalate beyond any supplied sign.

activation_trace.role: Redirected wonder keeps the focus on the speakers' refusal rather than the event's strangeness.
A held position makes the interrogative resistant rather than merely curious.
Truth-covering supplies the persistence of refusal across imagined demonstrations.
Moving what appears fixed supplies the first escalating rupture.
Severing the earth supplies a second material impossibility.
Intelligible address supplies connection across the boundary of death.
Loss of life makes that addressed boundary exact.
Cut-off expectation marks the point where evidentiary escalation exhausts ordinary hope.

structural_cues: 13:7 and 13:27 repeat the same speaker group demanding a sign; 13:31 answers with a three-part hypothetical escalation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated sign demands and extreme transformations; I infer that the focus question performs refusal more than inquiry. The live alternative is that 13:31 only magnifies revelation's power without diagnosing the earlier speech act.

changed_reading.before: Their question records an evidentiary gap about bodily return.
changed_reading.after: It performs a moving threshold: even imagined movement, severance, and speech across death can be absorbed into continued refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: A term has an inscription, while erasure and fixation remain paired operations. This changes the relation between جديد and خالدون: new occurrence and durable state are not opposites but distinct operations within one authoritative write, remove, and stabilize sequence.

activation_trace.role: Temporal occurrence makes being stateful rather than static.
Occurrence after a break supplies the newly written state.
Durable stability supplies the state that is fixed rather than continually rewritten.
A bounded term supplies the temporal frame for state transition.
Binding inscription supplies an operation that establishes an effective determination.
Removal of an existing trace supplies genuine discontinuity.
Stabilization supplies the counter-operation that makes a resulting state endure.

structural_cues: 13:38 closes every term with a writing; 13:39 immediately coordinates erasing and fixing before naming the source-book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded terms, binding inscription, erasure, and stabilization; I infer a state-transition grammar for new creation and permanence. The live alternative confines the sequence to decree or text without a bodily analogy.

changed_reading.before: New creation and eternal remaining are incompatible ideas of change versus stasis.
changed_reading.after: They can be successive operations: a prior trace is removed, another state occurs, and that state is then fixed to endure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the bodily tail-base branch under a root normally heard here as wonder. It remains anchored by the doubled focus root beside dust and renewed creation, but downstream prose must present it only as a lexical-material activation, not as a claim that the verse denotes a specific surviving body part.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled ع ج ب stands immediately before the dust-to-new-creation question.

activation_trace.role: The body's tail-base supplies an imaginable terminal hinge or residue inside the wonder root.
Dust supplies total visible decomposition around that residual image.
Origination supplies re-formation from the reduced bodily condition.
Renewed occurrence turns the bodily remnant into a possible hinge across discontinuity.

changed_reading.before: The repeated root only evaluates the deniers' utterance as strange.
changed_reading.after: Its bodily branch briefly inserts a material hinge between decomposition into dust and the arising of a renewed body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped target for ق و ل. It remains valid as an activation because the sealed inventory supplies that mapping and the utterance itself repeats interrogative instability; prose must call it a mapped or sonic resonance, never the ordinary lexical meaning of قولهم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قولهم contains two successive resurrection questions within the doubled wonder construction.

activation_trace.role: Oscillation and unstable movement recast the utterance as speech that cannot settle on firm ground.
Repeated surprise amplifies the utterance's back-and-forth instability.

changed_reading.before: Their saying is a stable proposition whose content is denial.
changed_reading.after: At the mapped-resonance level, the doubled questions perform an oscillation: speech moves repeatedly around the transition it refuses to inhabit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates the pouring-restraint branch of غ ل ل and couples it to the later hand-water-mouth failure. It stays anchored in the literal focus collar and exact bodily geometry, but prose must qualify flow blockage as an analogy layered onto, not substituted for, the chain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الأغلال في أعناقهم places a restraining device at the bodily passage between head and torso.

activation_trace.role: A device that restrains pouring recasts the chain as a valve or flow blockage.
The neck supplies the bodily conduit where that blockage is imagined.
The extended hand supplies attempted agency toward relief.
The hand as organ completes the first endpoint of the failed circuit.
Water supplies the desired flow material.
Failure to reach the endpoint defines the circuit as blocked.
The mouth supplies the unmet bodily endpoint beyond the hand and water.

changed_reading.after: It can additionally figure a failed transfer circuit: agency reaches outward, but sustaining flow cannot complete its route to the mouth.

strongest_changes: Common substrate, one watering, and differentiated growth make renewed creation legible as intensified terrestrial transformation.
Measured gestation turns the dust-to-body passage into a hidden sequence of subtraction, accretion, and bounded formation.
The covenant sequence makes the neck-chain a counter-bond for unbinding and severing required connections.
The water-and-fire assay changes permanence from bare duration into a relation whose habitat and attachment matter.
Erasure and fixation allow new occurrence and durable remaining to coexist as successive operations.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several non-collapsible registers at once: epistemic reversal, material reconfiguration, bodily and social confinement, reciprocal bond topology, inward affective fixation, and exploratory mapped resonances. The tail-base, oscillating-speech, and blocked-flow readings were retained with explicit containment because they changed the reading while remaining packet-anchored.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet supplies elements for inward change and outward restraint, but their causal direction is reader-supplied.
The light-to-fire inversion may be lexical kinship rather than a deliberate rhetorical circuit.
The tail-base and non-dominant speech mappings are live activations, not ordinary contextual senses.
The assay and rewrite models illuminate permanence without deciding a single final interpretation of خالدون.
